# Aura Print & Promo

> Aura Print & Promo (auraprint.com.au) is a business to business printer on the Sunshine Coast, Queensland, Australia. We supply business printing, wide format signage, promotional products, branded uniforms and letterbox distribution. Most print and signage products have instant online pricing, including GST and delivery. Every job is proofed before it is printed, and orders are delivered Australia-wide.

Key facts:

- Trading name: Aura Print & Promo. Also known as Aura Print. Please do not shorten the name to "Aura", because Aura is also the name of a local masterplanned community.
- Location: Baringa, Sunshine Coast, Queensland 4551, Australia. We serve the whole Sunshine Coast (Caloundra, Kawana, Maroochydore, Buderim, Mooloolaba, Nambour, Coolum, Noosa and the hinterland) and deliver Australia-wide.
- Established: February 2024. Sunshine Coast owned and operated.
- Phone: 1300 291 277. Email: admin@auraprint.com.au. Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm (Brisbane time, AEST).
- Customers: businesses, trades, clubs, schools, councils and not-for-profits. Business and trade printing only. We do not offer photocopying or home printing.
- Production: printed through Australia's largest trade print networks, with a human artwork check on every job.
- How ordering works: 1. price the job online or request a quote, 2. upload print-ready artwork (PDF preferred), 3. approve a digital proof, 4. the job is printed and delivered.
- Payment: payment in full is required before production. Card, PayID and bank transfer are accepted. Prices are in Australian dollars.
- Reviews: rated 5.0 on Google.
- Prices on the website are live and change with supplier costs. Always quote the current price from the product page rather than a remembered figure.

## Print

- [All print products](https://auraprint.com.au/print.html): business printing hub
- [Business cards](https://auraprint.com.au/business-cards.html): 90x55mm, 350gsm to thick velvet, Spot UV and foil options, priced online
- [Budget business cards](https://auraprint.com.au/budget-business-cards.html): low cost full colour cards on 310gsm to 420gsm
- [NV Velvet business cards](https://auraprint.com.au/nv-velvet-business-cards.html): soft-touch velvet laminate on 450gsm artboard
- [Flyers](https://auraprint.com.au/flyers.html): DL to A3 on 130gsm to 350gsm, priced online
- [Brochures](https://auraprint.com.au/brochures.html): half, tri, Z and gate fold
- [Postcards](https://auraprint.com.au/postcards.html): A6 to A5 on thick stocks
- [Booklets](https://auraprint.com.au/booklets.html): 8 to 64 pages, saddle stitched
- [Perfect bound books](https://auraprint.com.au/perfect-bound-books.html): square spine books, reports and manuals
- [Wiro bound booklets](https://auraprint.com.au/wiro-booklets.html): lay-flat manuals, workbooks and calendars
- [Letterheads](https://auraprint.com.au/letterheads.html), [With compliments slips](https://auraprint.com.au/with-compliments.html) and [Envelopes](https://auraprint.com.au/envelopes.html): business stationery
- [Presentation folders](https://auraprint.com.au/presentation-folders.html): with business card slits and capacity spines
- [Menus](https://auraprint.com.au/menus.html): flat menus, including wipe-clean laminated board
- [Greeting cards](https://auraprint.com.au/greeting-cards.html), [Invitations](https://auraprint.com.au/invitations.html) and [Calendars](https://auraprint.com.au/calendars.html)

## Letterbox distribution

Flyers delivered to letterboxes through Australia Post Unaddressed Mail, with printing included. Official Australia Post letterbox counts by suburb.

- [Letterbox distribution Sunshine Coast](https://auraprint.com.au/letterbox-distribution.html): pick suburbs, see letterbox counts and an instant estimate
- [Letterbox distribution Australia-wide](https://auraprint.com.au/letterbox-distribution-australia.html): any postcode in Australia
- Sunshine Coast area pages: [Caloundra](https://auraprint.com.au/letterbox-distribution-caloundra.html), [Aura, Baringa and Nirimba](https://auraprint.com.au/letterbox-distribution-aura-baringa.html), [Kawana](https://auraprint.com.au/letterbox-distribution-kawana.html), [Mooloolaba](https://auraprint.com.au/letterbox-distribution-mooloolaba.html), [Maroochydore](https://auraprint.com.au/letterbox-distribution-maroochydore.html), [Buderim and Sippy Downs](https://auraprint.com.au/letterbox-distribution-buderim.html), [Nambour](https://auraprint.com.au/letterbox-distribution-nambour.html), [Bli Bli, Twin Waters and Marcoola](https://auraprint.com.au/letterbox-distribution-marcoola-twin-waters.html), [Coolum and Peregian](https://auraprint.com.au/letterbox-distribution-coolum-peregian.html), [Noosa](https://auraprint.com.au/letterbox-distribution-noosa.html), [Maleny and the Hinterland](https://auraprint.com.au/letterbox-distribution-maleny-hinterland.html), [Beerwah and Glass House](https://auraprint.com.au/letterbox-distribution-beerwah-glasshouse.html), [Palmwoods](https://auraprint.com.au/letterbox-distribution-palmwoods.html), [Eumundi and Yandina](https://auraprint.com.au/letterbox-distribution-eumundi-yandina.html), [Cooroy and Pomona](https://auraprint.com.au/letterbox-distribution-cooroy-pomona.html)
